display_long_description:
Virtual Hall®: The immersive experience that redefines Great Music!

Powered by the revolutionary "Real Illusions XR engine," Virtual Hall®, created by Cybel'Art in collaboration with the Orchestre de la Suisse Romande, transports you to the heart of live performance.

A world first: experience the symphony orchestra in multi-360°!

Virtual Hall® establishes itself as the benchmark for immersive performances of orchestras, operas, and ballets directly from your living room.

Imagine: you're on stage, in the center of the action.

Surrounded by the musicians, facing the conductor, choose your viewing angle with multiple 360° HD cameras.

Discover the masterpieces of the classical repertoire like never before.

Experience the intensity of Beethoven's "Symphony No. 3 Eroica" and the brilliance of Rossini's "William Tell Overture." Let the realisation assistance guide you and enjoy studio-quality sound of exceptional purity.

A constantly expanding catalog for a limitless immersive hall.

Virtual Hall® enriches its offering with new works and prestigious ensembles, creating the world's most prominent virtual performance hall.

Virtual Hall®: Your seat at the heart of emotion.

Dive into an unforgettable musical and visual experience. The show is about to begin...
